name: Speak with Bink
summary: In Dun Morogh, Magis Sparkmantle sends novice mages to Ironforge at Bink's request. Bink needs an arcane specialist for her studies in the Hall of Mysteries.

sections.title: A Colleague's Summons
sections.body: Magis Sparkmantle sends word from his colleague Bink to mages training near Kharanos. She asks for an arcane specialist and will trust the matter only to someone who can wield magic. When an apprentice has outgrown the early exercises, Sparkmantle directs them to answer her call.

sections.title: The Hall of Mysteries
sections.body: You travel to Ironforge's Mystic Ward, where scholars, priests, and arcanists gather in the Hall of Mysteries. Bink studies there and watches each arriving apprentice closely. Raw potential is only a beginning; without discipline, a spellcaster can become a danger in arcane work.

faq.answer: Magis Sparkmantle sends novice Alliance mages who have advanced beyond their early training in Dun Morogh to Bink.
Bink is in the Hall of Mysteries, in the Mystic Ward in northern Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Bink only want a mage?
faq.answer: Bink's research concerns arcane energies and sensitive monitoring equipment. She believes non-mages cannot handle the magical details and dangers involved.

aliases: what comes after speak with bink
faq.answer: After greeting you and assessing your abilities, Bink asks you to help with her research, which continues with Mage-tastic Gizmonitor.

faq.q: Is this quest available to classes other than mages?
faq.answer: No. The call is for mages, bringing them from local novice training to specialized work in the capital.

faq.q: What is the Hall of Mysteries?
faq.answer: The Hall of Mysteries is Ironforge's center for arcane and holy study. Trainers, scholars, and researchers there represent the magical arts of dwarves and gnomes.

angles.text: As a mage, you leave introductory valley training for the wider work of Ironforge's arcane scholars.
As a gnome, you find Bink and Magis Sparkmantle carrying on gnomish arcane tradition in Ironforge's welcoming halls after the loss of Gnomeregan.
As an Alliance member, you see gnomish intellect and dwarven hospitality joined in study at the Hall of Mysteries.
